title: Only $80M was error correction.
source: SEC filing, Jun 7, 2019. Test fixture, not a supported issuer.
alt: Only $80M was error correction. Kraft Heinz FY2017 operating income was revised by $716M, from $6,773M to $6,057M: $80M error correction plus $636M presentation change (ASU 2017-07). Source: SEC filing, Jun 7, 2019. Kraft Heinz is a test fixture in this project, not a supported issuer.
